blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Canada is pitching its ability to build, power, and run data centers to the Philippines, its newest free trade market, as it seeks to position itself as a more reliable partner that “does not use trade as a weapon.” Maninder Sidhu, Canada’s minister of trade, said Ottawa currently has 200 data centers in the pipeline and a network of more than 3,500 artificial intelligence (AI) companies that employ over 150,000 Canadians. This level of expertise, he argued, presents a strong case for Canada to be a partner in building data centers in the Philippines. “Data centers are the factory […]...
